dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents from 5 to 10 October 2024 over Chiang Mai and Lamphun Provinces
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240912THA** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water extent from multiple satellites in Chiang Mai and Lamphun Provinces, Thailand, from 5 to 10 October 2024. Within the cloud-free analysed areas of about 4,000 km², about 245 km² of land appears to have been affected by flood waters, with around 70 km² of cropland inundated. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, about 228,000 people are exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
